View More Frequently Asked Questions Checkout our knowledge base for some of your answers! What is myScheme, and how is it different from other government portals? myScheme is a national platform for accessing a wide range of government schemes from both the Central & State/UT Governments. It is a one-stop platform for search & discovery of government schemes based on demographic details. Unlike traditional government portals, myScheme brings together schemes from the Central Government, State Governments, and Union Territories on a single platform and helps users find relevant schemes based on their eligibility. How will myScheme help common citizens? The myScheme platform simplifies access to government schemes by enabling citizens to discover relevant schemes in one place, eliminating the need to visit multiple departmental websites or review extensive scheme guidelines to check their eligibility. How does myScheme work? The myScheme platform follows a simple and user-friendly three-step process to help citizens discover government schemes for which they are eligible: Step 1: The user enters basic details such as demographic, income, social category, etc. Step 2: Based on the information provided, myScheme displays relevant schemes from hundreds of government schemes for the user. Step 3: The user can select from the list of eligible schemes and get more information from the dedicated scheme page with detailed knowledge, FAQs, and application process and navigate to the respective application URL to apply. What is the procedure for knowing the right scheme on the myScheme platform? To find the right scheme on the myScheme platform, citizens can begin by visiting the platform's official website. Once on the homepage, they will find the 'Find Schemes for You' feature, which allows users to enter their demographic details, such as age, gender, income level, category, etc. Once these details are submitted, the platform will provide a list of relevant schemes based on the user's profile. What information about a particular scheme can I find on myScheme? The myScheme platform provides comprehensive information on each scheme, including eligibility criteria, benefits offered, application procedure, and the documents required to avail the scheme. It also features a dedicated Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) section to address common queries related to the scheme.
